label: Putin stiffens into a black onyx tower with a sharp point
description: Putin seen dressed all in black and going stiff as a board, becoming onyx and then a black onyx tower with a sharp point rather than a flat top, likened to a sickle or an icicle and described as looking like a weapon. Given in connection with Iran, with Russia part of it. Given 30 August 2026.

label: Canada sends troops to the European war
description: The Canadian prime minister seen trying to send troops and men to fight in the widening European war, given alongside Poland, Italy and England being drawn in. Given 30 August 2026.
aliases: canada was trying to send troops

label: Zelenskyy becomes emboldened, and then more so
description: A word he says the Lord gave earlier that the Ukrainian president would become emboldened with France and the others, restated on 30 August 2026 with the addition that he will become even more emboldened as longer-range weapons arrive.
